hints.content:
The *scale factor* in a dilation changes every length in the figure and changes the distance of each point from the center of dilation.

$\dfrac{\text{length of image}}{\text{length of source}}=\text{scale factor}$

Segment $\overline{CD}$ has a length of $6$ units.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A first quadrant coordinate plane. The image and pre-image of quadrilaterals are graphed. The pre-image quadrilateral has vertices A at six, zero, B at zero, three, C at three, three and D at three, nine. The image quadrilateral has vertices A prime at ten, eight, B prime at eight, nine, C prime at nine, nine and D prime at nine, eleven.
